cases.note: memql#5429. A string after a key that is not a direction starts the next key, so "sideways" loaded as a second key and sorted on nothing. Written where a direction goes, and naming no field, it is refused as an unknown direction.
Lower case is the spelling to write, but a direction is read in any case, and "DESC" always ordered descending, so it loads.
